text.b2: To a computer, a photo is only ones and zeros.
text.s1: Your phone, in Hyderabad. You tap send.
text.s2: First, the photo breaks into tiny pieces.
text.s3: Every piece is just ones and zeros.
text.s4: Your whole photo, only ones and zeros.
text.s6: If anyone tries to look, they find nothing. Only noise.
text.o1: But where do all these pieces go?
text.o2: And then, it has to cross an entire ocean.
text.p1: Now it is cut into about 2,000 packets.
text.p2: Every packet gets a label: where it is going, where it came from, and its number.
text.p3: Then radio waves carry them to a mobile tower.
text.p5: A box at the bottom turns it into light, and sends it down a glass cable, under the street.
